verses.1: A message for David, as he fled from Abishalom.
verses.2: Yehova, how many troubles and difficulties are there that arise against me!
verses.3: Many say to my soul, “There is no salvation for him in God.”
verses.4: And you, LORD, be my protection and my defense. May you lift up my head.
verses.5: My voice cries out to the LORD; He will answer me from His holy place.
verses.6: I lay down, and my companion woke up. For the LORD will guide me.
verses.7: I do not see any people’s roofs around here.
verses.8: May the LORD, my God, come to me and save me, for you have taken away all my enemies. Two wicked people have been destroyed.
verses.9: May the Lord, who saves your people, grant you his blessings.
